coverage.note: Densest lens in the corpus: argued across twenty of the thirty bound sources and tested on the real host and on Intake's own corpus; three owner decisions (source-trust boundary, verified-save-only, the H-032 'absence from main is not never-built' correction) and a recurring 'no second truth' law. The corpus's own rule that recurrence across these conversations is shared prior context, not independent corroboration, is carried here and qualifies every convergence claim in this compile. Residual: role truth is inherited from capture; claim fidelity of any derived layer stays judgement.

Owner-decided on ambition (world-class, textbook + radical, non-slop, full steps) and heavily argued for the web förvaltning; the Foundation repair chain is tested in reality. What is missing: no world-class definition has been falsified, the competence register said VALIDATING with about one datapoint, and 'Webbförvaltningen complete' is undefined.

The kommun metaphor, 'Tillsammans är vi Nortropic', Nortropic ≠ Digitala and the workstream split are owner-decided; Organization OS is extensively argued but nothing of it is built, its master prompt lineage is unratified, naming drifts, Owner vs Managing Director is open, and the one method the owner named himself (Scrum) was declined by the assistant rather than decided.

Direction is owner-decided many times over (autonomy as principle, attention over stops, 90/10), but the corpus itself names Executive Function — who decides what work exists — the largest unexplored gap; the attention mechanisms are assistant proposals which the owner repeatedly commissioned as prompts — including the very prompt that delivered the hard-stop taxonomy — and adopted en bloc without wording any boundary himself, and merge authority in practice is unstated. Research-shaped, not build-shaped.

Session continuity and provider handoff are tested in reality (real losses, real recoveries, reload-not-remember written after a loss) — including one recovery the owner authorized that explicitly did not restore the original bytes; 'operate forever' as degraded states, SLOs, continuity tiers and recovery drills exists only as assistant proposals; fresh-session recovery is proven synthetically, not on a real item.

The corpus says it plainly: no real production economics exist, so no cost caps yet — instrument first; identity, authority leases, tenant isolation and the memory firewall are argued but not built; the two compliance alarms were verified against primary sources while the replacement channels they imply were not. What is missing is contact with measured reality, not more argument.

Direction owner-decided (cannot stand still, yrkeserfarenhet, practice bank, co-evolution) and the loop shape recurs in twenty-two instantiations across seven conversations of one project (shared prior context, not independent corroboration); the only learning loop that actually ran is Intake's own proving-run discipline. Web Gym, harness ablation, PROVEN_FOR revalidation and the Evolution Engine are unbuilt designs.

The most owner-decided lens: a dozen explicit owner decisions and four review-queue entries the owner answered by submitting assistant-authored wording; the tool lineage v1 → v4 was built, frozen, broken by reality and re-frozen, and this compile is the lens's own dogfood. Still open: 'rensa', attachments, Sources tab, the Recompile mission spec, and Function Intake's future.

Adversarial review is practised, not just argued: cross-provider review caught real defects, independent gate adjudication ran, measurement was falsified repeatedly, proving runs broke the tooling on purpose. The 'too much' attacker (bureaucracy falsifier), held-out evals and the proposed negative-control canaries remain unrun.

Strong owner signals in own words (Lovable ambition, 'som mat', 'i det enkla bor det vackra', overwhelming Verkstadsgolvet, weeks of relaying) and a qualitative construct set (time to magic, stuckness, bypass pressure); the one operator surface that exists was evaluated only as the owner's own overwhelm verdict on it; none of the surfaces this lens proposes — the cockpit rebuild, the Operator Portal, the Aquarium — was built, and nothing is measured. Kept qualitative by design — no score.

Nortropic does build Nortropic (bootstrap on the real host, Intake on its own corpus, Foundation repair), 'Nortropic as Customer #1' is owner-decided and a Reality Layer — real users, real organisations, real production outcomes over simulation — is an owner-adopted first-class requirement — but the decisive reality contacts (first real autonomous launch, first full customer run, Customer Zero loop, the service-trap test) have not happened; the corpus's own audit calls Nortropic strategically fail-open.

The corpus makes many unknowns explicit (residual-risk registers, NEEDS_EVIDENCE classes, owner deferrals via RQ-023/025/026 and the freeze policy), but no consolidated register existed before this compile and several material unknowns are implicit silences (merge authority, whether prompts were sent, first-run outcome). Deferrals that are owner acts are recorded as such; the rest is UNKNOWN, never implicitly rejected.
